text: Sinte Romani is a stable language of Germany. It belongs to the Indo-European language family and is part of the Romany macrolanguage.

title: Romani, Sinte
text: Sinte Romani is the variety of Romani spoken by the Sinti people in Germany, France, Austria, Belgium, the Netherlands, some parts of Northern Italy and other adjacent regions.

title: Sinte Romani
text: Sinte Romani maintains a core phonological inventory derived from Early Romani, with modifications due to prolonged contact with German and other Germanic languages in Northwestern Europe.
